tools.name: read_logs
tools.description: Read recent Unity/BepInEx log messages captured by DevMCP. Use this to see console output, errors, warnings, and mod logs.

count.description: Number of recent log entries to retrieve (default: 100, max: 1000)

filter.description: Optional text filter - only returns logs containing this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: clear_logs
tools.description: Clear the DevMCP log buffer. This removes all stored log messages.

tools.name: execute_csharp
tools.description:
Evaluate reflection-based C# member chains, property assignments, and method calls at runtime in the Unity game context.
Has access to all Unity namespaces and loaded game/mod assemblies.

Supported syntax (reflection evaluator, NOT a Roslyn compiler):
- Member/property/method chains: return UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name;
- Property/field assignment: UnityEngine.Time.timeScale = 1.0f
- Variables from member calls: var go = UnityEngine.GameObject.Find("Player"); return go.transform.position;
- Generic static methods: UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Camera>()

Limitations: no arithmetic/boolean operators (+, &&, ?:), no lambdas/LINQ delegates, and no bare literal assignments (e.g. var x = 10;).

code.description: C# code to execute. Should return a value or perform an action.

tools.name: evaluate_expression
tools.description:
Evaluate a simple C# expression (property access, method call, or assignment) and return the result.

Examples:
- "UnityEngine.Time.time"
- "UnityEngine.Application.productName"
- "UnityEngine.QualitySettings.GetQualityLevel()"

tools.name: get_scene_info
tools.description: Get information about the currently loaded Unity scene including name, build index, and root object count.

tools.name: list_game_objects
tools.description:
List GameObjects in the current scene hierarchy.
Returns a tree structure of GameObjects with their components, active state, and children.
Use depth parameter to control how deep to traverse (default: 2).

filter.description: Optional name filter - only returns objects containing this text

activeOnly.description: If true, only return active GameObjects (default: false)

tools.name: find_game_object
tools.description:
Find an active GameObject by Unity GameObject.Find path/name, or any GameObject by instanceId.
Paths use '/' as separator (e.g., 'Canvas/Panel/Button').
To search inactive objects or match by substring, use list_game_objects or find_objects_of_type.

instanceId.description: Instance ID of the GameObject (alternative to path)

includeChildren.description: Include child objects in result (default: true)

tools.name: list_components
tools.description:
List all components attached to a GameObject.
Returns component type names, enabled state (for Behaviours), and instance IDs.

instanceId.description: Instance ID of the GameObject (alternative to path)

tools.name: inspect_component
tools.description:
Inspect a component's properties, fields, and methods.
Returns all public members and their values. Use includePrivate to also show private members.

gameObjectPath.description: Path to the GameObject containing the component

gameObjectId.description: Instance ID of the GameObject (alternative to path)

componentType.description: Name or full name of the component type to inspect

componentIndex.description: Index of the component if multiple of same type exist (default: 0)

tools.name: toggle_behaviour
tools.description:
Enable or disable a MonoBehaviour component.
This controls whether the component receives Update, FixedUpdate, and other callbacks.

gameObjectPath.description: Path to the GameObject containing the behaviour

gameObjectId.description: Instance ID of the GameObject (alternative to path)

componentIndex.description: Index if multiple components of same type (default: 0)

enabled.description: Set to true to enable, false to disable

tools.name: set_property
tools.description:
Set a property or field value on a Unity object (GameObject or Component).
Supports basic types (string, int, float, bool) and some Unity types (Vector3, Color).

gameObjectId.description: Instance ID of the GameObject (alternative to path)

componentType.description: Component type name (omit to set property on GameObject itself)

componentIndex.description: Index if multiple components of same type (default: 0)

propertyName.description: Name of the property or field to set

value.description: Value to set (will be parsed based on property type)

tools.name: invoke_method
tools.description:
Invoke a method on a Unity object (GameObject or Component).
Methods can be called with arguments. The result is returned as text.

gameObjectId.description: Instance ID of the GameObject (alternative to path)

componentType.description: Component type name (omit to call method on GameObject)

componentIndex.description: Index if multiple components of same type (default: 0)

methodName.description: Name of the method to invoke

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the method (as JSON array of strings)

tools.name: get_game_info
tools.description:
Get information about the running game including:
- Game name, developer, version
- Unity version and BepInEx version
- Platform information
- Current scene information
- Screen resolution

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the current game view. Returns the image as base64-encoded PNG data.

saveToFile.description: Optional file path to save the screenshot (must resolve inside the game root directory)

tools.name: get_time_info
tools.description:
Get Unity time information including:
- Current time, delta time, fixed delta time
- Time scale (for slow-motion or pause detection)
- Frame count
- Real time since startup

tools.name: list_assemblies
tools.description:
List all assemblies loaded in the game process.
This includes Unity assemblies, game assemblies, and mod assemblies.
Use the filter parameter to search for specific assemblies.

includeSystem.description: Include System.* and Microsoft.* assemblies (default: false)

tools.name: list_types
tools.description:
List types (classes, structs, enums, interfaces) in an assembly.
Use filters to narrow down the results.

assemblyName.description: Name of the assembly to inspect

limit.description: Maximum number of types to return (default: 100)

tools.name: get_type_info
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a specific type including:
- Properties, fields, methods, constructors
- Base type and interfaces
- Static members

typeName.description: Full name or simple name of the type

tools.name: find_objects_of_type
tools.description:
Find all Unity objects of a specific type in the scene.
Useful for finding all instances of a component type like 'Camera', 'Light', 'AudioSource', or custom game types.

typeName.description: The type name to search for (e.g., 'Camera', 'Light', 'MonoBehaviour')

tools.name: set_time_scale
tools.description:
Set the Unity time scale.
0 = paused, 1 = normal speed, 0.5 = half speed, 2 = double speed.

tools.name: cursor_control
tools.description: Control the mouse cursor visibility and lock state.

tools.name: load_scene
tools.description: Load a Unity scene by name or build index (single or additive).

sceneName.description: Name of the scene to load

buildIndex.description: Build index of the scene (alternative to sceneName)

additive.description: Load additively instead of replacing current scene (default: false)

tools.name: instantiate_object
tools.description: Clone an existing GameObject at the same or specified position.

sourceGameObjectPath.description: Path to the GameObject to clone

sourceGameObjectId.description: Instance ID of the GameObject to clone (alternative to path)

position.description: Position for the new object as 'x,y,z' (optional)

tools.name: create_primitive
tools.description: Create a new primitive GameObject (Cube, Sphere, Capsule, Cylinder, Plane, Quad).

tools.name: set_transform
tools.description: Set the position, rotation (euler angles in degrees), or scale of a GameObject's transform.

gameObjectId.description: Instance ID of the GameObject (alternative to path)

tools.name: inspect_material
tools.description: Inspect the material(s) on a GameObject's renderer (shader, color, texture info).

gameObjectId.description: Instance ID of the GameObject (alternative to path)

materialIndex.description: Index of the material to inspect (default: all materials)

tools.name: destroy_object
tools.description: Destroy a GameObject or component. WARNING: This cannot be undone!

gameObjectPath.description: Path to the GameObject to destroy

gameObjectId.description: Instance ID of the GameObject (alternative to path)

componentType.description: If specified, only destroy this component instead of the whole GameObject

tools.name: add_game_knowledge
tools.description:
Add a discovery to the game knowledge base.
Categories include: 'console_commands', 'static_accessors', 'cheats', 'type_info', 'useful_methods', 'config', 'notes'.

tools.name: get_game_knowledge
tools.description: Query the game knowledge base by category, search term, or list all stored games.

gameName.description: Game name (optional, defaults to current game)

listGames.description: List all games with stored knowledge

tools.name: get_game_summary
tools.description: Get a quick summary of all stored knowledge for the current game.

tools.name: set_pseudocode_path
tools.description: Set the path to optional decompiled/pseudocode source for the current game.

path.description: Path to decompiled source directory (relative to game root or absolute)

tools.name: search_pseudocode
tools.description: Search the game's optional decompiled source for type definitions, methods, or patterns.

tools.name: read_pseudocode_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a specific file within the optional pseudocode directory.
